envelope.description: Add EvidenceProvider interface/registry and SecurityEvidence shape

body.title: Add EvidenceProvider interface/registry and SecurityEvidence shape
body.summary: Add the `EvidenceProvider` interface/registry stub for the five deterministic evidence-provider categories (secret scanning, SAST, dependency/SBOM, IaC/container, language-native checks), distinct from the general tool registry, with a common input/output contract. Add `SecurityEvidence` (providerCategory + an optional SecurityLocator) feeding SecurityFinding.evidence uniformly. Extension-point only: no real daemon-IPC wiring or provider implementations in this Story.
acceptanceChecks: EvidenceProvider interface defines a common input/output contract shared by all five provider categories
SecurityEvidence carries providerCategory and an optional SecurityLocator-typed locator field
